## Story Goal

An authenticated agent can open a **Raise ticket** screen, choose a **customer** (by id — customer search
is out of scope), pick a **category** from a server-supplied list, pick a **priority** from the fixed set (`low |
normal | high | urgent`), fill **subject** and **description**, and submit. On success the screen shows the created ticket (id, status, category, priority, subject) rather than a
generic "Created" toast. On a 422 the field the API named is the field the screen marks and the one keyed sentence for `V

ALIDATION_FAILED` is shown. Submit is disabled while the request is in flight.

**In scope:** the form, category loading, subm

ission, success rendering, error handling, i18n in `en` and `ar`, unit tests, route wiring.

**Out of scope:

** editing, status transitions, assignment, the queue screen (CRM-74), customer search, any `api/` change.

Statuses are the fixed set `new | open | pending | resolved | closed | reopened`. Priorities are the fixed set `low | normal | high | urgent`. This story only chooses a **

- **S

C-1** — One organisation, one queue. The form does not offer a queue selector.
- **BR-6** — Every string on the screen comes from `en.ts` / `ar.ts`. No literal user

-facing text in the component.

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **Missing required field** — API answ
ers `422 { code: 'VALIDATION_FAILED', fields: [...] }`. Enforced in `RaiseTicketPage.tsx` error branch: each field in `error.fields` is

marked; one keyed sentence `ticketsRaise.errorValidationFailed` is shown. Verified in `RaiseTicketPage.test.tsx`.
- **Retired category present

in API response** — filtered out in `useTicketCategories.ts` before returning. Verified in a dedicated test.
- **Second page of categories** — the lo
ader iterates until the pagination cursor is exhausted. If only page one is honoured, a category on page two sil

ently disappears; test injects a two-page response and asserts a page-two category is offered.
- **Categories still loading when the user hits subm

it** — submit is disabled until the categories hook status is `success`. Enforced in `RaiseTicketPage.tsx`.
- **Double-click on submit** — the button is `disabled` when the raise
hook is `loading`; `useRaiseTicket.submit` is also a no-op in that state. Test asserts exactly one `POST` after two rapid clicks. Remember L

-30: the fetch stub must build a **fresh `Response` per call**.
- **401 mid-session** — mapped to `ticketsRaise.err

orUnauthenticated`. The auth-context redirect is not this story's responsibility; just show the message.
- **5xx** — mapped to `ticketsRaise.errorInternal`.
- **Empty category list from a healthy API** — render `<EmptyState>` with a `ticketsRaise.categoryError` fallback or a
specific `categoryEmpty` key (add a key rather than compose text); form remains inert

.
- **Arabic layout** — no mirrored styles (see `web/src/shared/i18n/no-mirrored-styles.test.ts`).

Use logical CSS properties in `RaiseTicketPage.css`.
- **BR-6 leakage** — a bare English string in the component would be

caught by `web/src/pages/no-hardcoded-strings.test.ts`. Do not disable it.
